Associate Product Manager - Growth
ShareChat
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Flexible / Hybrid)

About ShareChat:
India's largest homegrown social media and short video platform.

What you'll do:
• Drive viral referral loops, creator onboarding, and retention experiments.
• Write comprehensive PRDs, wireframing user flows, and collaborating with design.
• Partner with data scientists on recommendation feed A/B testing.

Requirements:
• 1-2 years of product experience in consumer internet apps.
• Data-driven approach with hands-on SQL and Mixpanel expertise.
• Bachelor's degree from any reputed college.
